key_terms.فُرُشٍ: Maidens of paradise (Hoor al-Ayn), specifically referring to their elevated status
key_terms.مَّرْفُوعَةٍ: Elevated, raised in rank or beauty

ai.seo_question: What does 'furush marfoo'at' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'furushin marfoo'ah' (elevated beds) is interpreted both literally as the luxurious couches of Paradise and metaphorically as the high spiritual station of the righteous, particularly the Ahl al-Bayt. This phrase underscores the divine reward for those who attain closeness to God, linking physical comfort with elevated spiritual purity and eternal bliss.
